name: Quick Check v2: Stable Ingestion First

goals.title: Roadmap and PR boundary
doneCriteria: PLAN.md exists under docs/roadmaps/quickcheck-v2/
phase-status.json exists with all goals listed
no production code changed
roadmap validation passes

goals.title: Envira ingestion only — canonical extracted JSON
doneCriteria: src/lib/quickCheckV2/ingestion/ creates deterministic canonical JSON from Envira
10 key strings found with correct page/span/section provenance
no scoring
no answers
no statuses
no LLM
no Blob dependency in tests
page 1 is not the default for every span

goals.title: Section tree and evidence spans
doneCriteria: section tree built from canonical JSON
direct body under exact heading only — no descendant sweeping
each of six checks can return top evidence span

goals.title: Evidence retrieval for six structured checks
doneCriteria: fixed source priority: fact contract → exact section → raw text fallback
no router candidates for structured checks
no scoring or term bonuses
Envira returns correct evidence with quote/page/section/span

goals.title: Tiny answer extractors
doneCriteria: each of six checks has a small, check-specific extractor
answers come from selected evidence only
no LLM final answers
no generic summarizer

goals.title: Boring deterministic status validator
doneCriteria: FOUND = answer + quote + page + section + span
UNCLEAR = related evidence but incomplete
MISSING = no usable evidence
validators do not search, rank, or invent answers

goals.title: Gold Envira fixture
doneCriteria: Envira gold fixture with expected answer, status, gold quote, page, section, span ID
known junk to reject included
gold is PDF truth, not current output
fails on known broken patterns ("of", boilerplate-only, wrong section, missing provenance)

goals.title: Add PDFs slowly by new failure mode only
doneCriteria: each new PDF introduces a structural/evidence failure mode Envira does not cover
one PDF per PR
each PR states new failure mode and why code change (if any) is generic

phase_meta.summary: Rebuild Quick Check from clean ingestion up. PDF → canonical JSON → section tree → evidence spans → answer → status. One layer per PR. No scoring. No LLM finals. No Blob test dependency.
phase_meta.current_focus: Goal 0 complete (roadmap boundary). Next: Goal 1 — Envira ingestion.
